reviews.text: Had my dog groomed here a while ago. I asked for a deshedding, and he came back shedding way way more than when I dropped him off. Clumps of fur were falling off him. 100% a ripoff because I doubt they even brushed him like they said they did.

Our perfect girl looks beautiful after her spa day at Tail Spin! It’s clear that Dee is very knowledgeable and is passionate about what she does, which left us feeling confident that we were leaving our baby in good hands. Thanks, Dee! We will be back!
Been going here for many years. Always fantastic work. Dee is so accommodating. My dog LOVES Tailspin and is always thrilled when we arrive, which is the best review

I highly highly recommend Tailspin. my dog Jaxon is 11 and has been going here since his first 6 months puppy trim. He loves going and seeing Deidre or the other groomers and always comes out looking fantastic and smelling great. Huge attention to detail and really fine scissor work. Wouldn’t go anywhere else

Tailspin has been the most consistent and dependable groomer for our dogs. After trying out another groomer and having an unfortunate experience we will absolutely be staying loyal to Tailspin! Thank you to the team for always pampering our girls.

Had a great experience with nervous dog getting his nails trimmed.  Staff were professional and kind with our dog; we were in and out faster than I would have imagined which for sure made it easier for him too.
Dee is the best!
Fantastic service! Brought our pup in for a full groom session and he was done within three hours. The staff are fantastic and the price is very reasonable. Highly recommend!
Coco had such a good experience at Tail Spin Dog SPA. The groomer was very patient. She came home clean, fluffy, and happy. I’ll definitely be back!

I cannot recommend this salon enough! I brought my daughter, Whisky, in for a groom today, and she came out looking absolutely incredible. It is hands down the cutest cut she has ever had. They really paid attention to the details and made her look like a superstar.
​Beyond the look, I was so impressed by the gentle care the staff provided. Whisky can be a bit sensitive, but the groomers especially (Arianna I highly recommend her what a sweet heart)were incredibly patient and kind with her. She seemed so calm and happy when I picked her up, which tells me she was in great hands.
​If you’re looking for a place that combines expert styling with a truly caring touch, this is it. We will definitely be back!
Super friendly, knowledgeable staff...my Zorro and Stella leave happy and love the staff like family.  They smell amazing and are so FLUFFY!! I wouldn't go anywhere else!

Took my dog Max here and I’m really happy with the service. He had some matting and the groomer took the time to carefully work through it. You can tell they really care about the dogs. Max looked so much better after!

I brought my dog Taro to Tail Spin Dog SPA and had a really great experience. Ariana was very patient and took the time to explain everything, especially about his ears and matting. You can tell they really care about the dogs’ comfort and health. Taro came back clean, happy, and well taken care of. Highly recommend!
After my dog's hair was cut, it kept scratching its ears for many days. I can understand that they charge extra for detangling, but I'm not very satisfied with the service.
Very professional pet groomer Ariana who also treats dogs and cats with care, would definitely come visit again.
Ariana is really gentle and patient with dogs, I'll still go back to ask her to do it again ‼️

I had such a great experience at Tail Spin Dog Spa! Ariana did an amazing job grooming my dog .you can really tell she pays attention to detail and genuinely cares about the pets she works with.

My dog usually gets a bit nervous during grooming, but Ariana was so patient , which made a huge difference. The haircut turned out super clean and exactly what I was hoping for. He looked (and smelled!) so good after 🐶✨

Highly recommend Ariana if you’re looking for someone reliable and skilled. Will definitely be coming back!
What a great spa!  My Ollie looks like a movie star after Dee and staff tidy him up.

Not saying they’re necessarily bad, just that they do not give off a very friendly vibe. So Im not sure how accommodating to sensitive dogs they might be behind closed doors.

Also found some blood on one of the nails clipped, which in all fairness can happen but i prefer it not to with a professional!

Gave her a brushing after she came out from a shower and brush and there was still alot of hair there.

Overall feels like a “business” kind of establishment more than a safe space for my dog.

Update: it doesn’t cancel the fact that i had to brush her after coming back from the groomer, and the over clipped nails which caused the bleeding, not what you want from a groomer. Ignoring these two facts from your response gave me a clear idea that it is a business only, not a safe space for my dog.
Excellent care and service.  Amazing friendly staff too!

I’ve been taking my dog here to get his nails done since our old spot closed down and I wish I started coming sooner! Dee is so kind to humans and furry friends alike - my very nail trim-averse dog is in and out in a breeze.
Always wonderful!! Skye and I thank the crew for making her feel safe and of course making her tidy up so welll!!!

Zena & Zuff are happy with their pretty nails. Thank you to Dee who helped make me feel like home when I came in with my babies. I suggest this place for anyone in the area looking for a groomer. Thank you - Kylie
Always great
Barkley’s been going here for ten years now every time comes out looking so handsome! They take great care of your fur babies here!
I love coming here and so does my dog! Great service and work.

If your looking for a good groomer I would recommend this place! Our groomer moved locations so I did ny research and found this location. Deidre was very gentle and kind with our Mini Aussie, and the end result was amazing. Location is great and within walking distance. We've found our new groomer and will definitely be back!

This was my second time bringing my dog here. The first time was great, but unfortunately, this time was very disappointing. When we got home, I noticed my dog’s eyes were red and irritated, and it has stayed that way since. I now have to take him to the vet. I suspect that shampoo or something else may have gotten into his eyes during the grooming. I’m very upset and concerned for his comfort and safety.

I've been bringing my dog Leo to Tail Spin for years, and I can’t imagine going anywhere else! The entire team is amazing, but Dee is truly the BEST. She’s incredibly talented, kind, and always makes Leo look absolutely adorable after every groom. What I love most is how honest and transparent she is—she always walks me through what Leo needs and what she’s going to do, so I know he’s in the best hands.

Leo genuinely loves his spa days at Tail Spin—he gets so excited when we arrive, and he’s always happy, relaxed, and smelling amazing when I pick him up! It gives me such peace of mind knowing he’s being so well cared for by people who truly love what they do.

I can’t recommend Tail Spin enough. If you’re looking for a place that treats your pup like family and makes them look and feel their best, this is it!
Started taking our chihuahua here for nail trims after our previous groomer became unreliable. Service here is always fast and friendly - I always call to confirm when it’s a good time to stop in.
Very good dog spa service in downtown. Took my dog there for a nail trim, all went well and quick. Will likely return
I enjoy taking my dog there for his grooms. They are reasonably priced, are friendly, handle him with care, and do a thorough job of all the services I request.
We would absolutely not take our beloved pup anywhere else. They do amazing work, incredibly chill and calm and he loves Greg! They are absolutely the best!
